title: BTC Pushed Above the TBO Cloud - $100k Next?! (haha no)
description:
BTC finally got the breakout bulls wanted. Price closed above long-term overhead resistance, pushed to the top of the daily cloud for the first time since late October, and now has the open CME gap near $81,145 in view. The move has been strong, but daily RSI is flashing bearish divergence while price tests the weekly Fast line, so I still think this is a spot to stay disciplined rather than chase.

ETH also had a good close, but it is still lagging BTC and remains below key resistance. BTC.D pushed higher again, stablecoin dominance is behaving oddly, and OTHERS.D still shows why most alts are struggling to keep up. TOTALES broke above long-term resistance too, but this still feels like Bitcoin leadership first, not a broad alt breakout.

Macro is supporting risk for now, but a lot of charts already look stretched. DXY bounced, USDJPY remains bullish, equities are extended, and the Nikkei keeps pushing higher. My base case is still that May and June lean red, even if BTC squeezes a bit higher first.
